name: Green River (Labyrinth Canyon)
gaugeName: Green River at Green River, UT
blurb: Flatwater canoe/raft trip from the town of Green River through Labyrinth Canyon to Mineral Bottom. BLM permit required (downloaded and emailed to BLM).

sections.putIn: Green River State Park Boat Ramp
sections.notes: BLM: minimum 3-4 days for the 68 river-miles; BLM permit required (downloaded and emailed to BLM; none submitted by this package; fee not stated). Mineral Bottom road: high clearance/4WD recommended, impassable when wet, steep switchbacks. Ruby Ranch alternative launch is private (fee).

guideTimes.conditions: BLM recommends a minimum planning allowance of three to four days for the 68-mile trip. This is a trip itinerary; allow longer as conditions require.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM Moab FO: Labyrinth Canyon River (permit page)
putInAccess.note: Imagery: the UGRC 2009 point is on the sand ramp beside the dock (looks right), but there is no current agency coordinate. Coordinate comes from the 2009 UGRC boat-ramp layer, not from a Utah State Parks page; State Parks ramp-status page was blocked (403) so current ramp status not confirmed. Restrictions: fee-area; permit-required-downstream
putInAccess.directions: Green River State Park boat ramp (Utah State Parks), town of Green River.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: BLM Moab FO: Labyrinth Canyon River; Mineral Bottom Recreation Site
takeOutAccess.note: Imagery: the BLM GIS point is on the access road about 60-70 m south of the launch area, not on the ramp. The NPS POI (38.5249, -109.9933) sits at the launch beside the water: see research/replacement-proposals-UT.json. NHD is 111 m away. Official source names boating access, but the exact water-entry point is not pinned by an agency coordinate confirmed on imagery. Restrictions: 4wd-high-clearance; impassable-when-wet; steep-switchbacks
takeOutAccess.directions: End of the Mineral Bottom road (Horsethief switchbacks) at the Green River; BLM Mineral Bottom Recreation Site.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
